niche: Fitness for busy working adults: short, effective strength and cardio workouts that fit in a lunch break, plus simple training habits for people with full-time jobs.
audience: Adults 25-45 with desk jobs who want to get stronger and fitter but only have 30-45 minutes a day.
tone: Direct, encouraging, practical. No hype, no guru talk, no shaming.
cta_line: Save this for your next lunch break
